painPoints.title: We know the challenges you face
painPoints.subtitle: Buying property in Spain as a foreigner can be complex. We simplify every step.

distance.title: You live far away
distance.text: Managing a mortgage process from the US is overwhelming. We handle everything remotely so you don't have to travel until signing day.

paperwork.title: Spanish bureaucracy
paperwork.text: NIE, notary, taxes, bank requirements — the paperwork is endless. Our experts guide you through every step.

banks.title: Banks reject foreigners
banks.text: Spanish banks are cautious with non-residents. We have exclusive agreements with 45+ banks to get you approved.

costs.title: Hidden costs
costs.text: Taxes, fees, insurance — costs add up fast. We give you a full transparent breakdown before you commit to anything.

howItWorks.title: How we get you your mortgage
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple, transparent and fully managed from start to finish.

step1.title: Free consultation
step1.text: Tell us your situation — where you live, what property you want, your budget. We assess your eligibility at no cost.

step2.title: We find the best offer
step2.text: We negotiate with 45+ Spanish banks on your behalf and bring you the best conditions available for your profile.

step3.title: We handle the paperwork
step3.text: NIE, documentation, bank forms — we manage everything. You just review and approve at each stage.

step4.title: Sign and get your keys
step4.text: We accompany you to the notary for the final signing. Your Spanish home is ready.

testimonials.title: Trusted by clients buying in Spain
